title: General Knowledge Practice Test
description: A comprehensive practice test covering general knowledge topics including science, history, geography, and literature. Answer all questions within the time limit.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for water?
questions.explanation: Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.question: Who wrote "Romeo and Juliet"?
questions.explanation: William Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet around 1594-1596.

questions.question: What is the largest mammal?
questions.explanation: The blue whale can reach up to 100 feet in length.

questions.question: In which year did World War II end?
questions.explanation: World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Japan.

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria generate most of the cell's ATP.

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Plants use CO₂ in photosynthesis to produce glucose and oxygen.

questions.question: What is the speed of light approximately?
questions.explanation: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 3 × 10⁸ m/s.

questions.question: Which element has the atomic number 1?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest and most abundant element.
